title: Brand & Marketing Executive
description:
Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 (negotiable Depending on experience)

Hours: Monday to Friday, typically 7:30am - 4:30pm (with a degree of flexibility)

Benefits
- Company-wide bonus scheme
- Lunch provided
- 23 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Auto-enrolment pension
- On-site parking
- Collaborative and close-knit team environment

Are you a creative marketer who enjoys bringing brands to life through exceptional presentations, marketing collateral and compelling customer communications?

This is an opportunity to join a growing, design-led SME business that works with premium brands around the world. Rather than focusing on strategy creation, your role will be to take an established marketing direction and execute it brilliantly across multiple channels, helping to ensure the business presents itself consistently, professionally and creatively at every customer touchpoint.

This role would suit a confident and commercially aware marketing professional who enjoys being hands-on, can work independently and takes pride in producing polished, high-quality marketing materials.

The Opportunity

As the key marketing professional within the business, you will work closely with commercial, project and design teams to create engaging communications that strengthen the company's brand position and support ongoing growth.

You'll be given autonomy to manage day-to-day marketing activity whilst collaborating with experienced colleagues across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Communications & Marketing Materials
- Create professional customer presentations, sales decks and pitch materials
- Produce brochures, case studies and branded marketing collateral
- Ensure visual consistency across all customer-facing communications
- Develop engaging digital marketing assets

Content & Copywriting
- Create and edit compelling marketing copy
- Develop content for customer communications and email campaigns
- Produce engaging case studies and marketing literature
- Support ongoing website content updates and improvements

Internal Communications
- Create presentations and communication materials for internal initiatives
- Help ensure consistent brand messaging throughout the business
- Support the development of marketing resources used across departments

Marketing Operations
- Maintain marketing assets, literature and sample materials
- Coordinate marketing suppliers and external partners
- Manage marketing files, resources and documentation
- Handle inbound enquiries and direct opportunities to the appropriate teams

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have experience in a creative marketing, brand marketing or marketing communications position and can demonstrate a strong portfolio of work.

You will ideally possess:
- Experience in a marketing, brand or communications role
- Experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop, or similar creative software
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills
- A strong eye for detail and brand consistency
- The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, self-starting approach
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to work closely with customer-facing teams
- You are willing to be accountable for the results of your work

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and turning ideas into high-quality marketing output that delivers real business impact.

Apply

If you're looking for a varied marketing role where you'll have the opportunity to influence how a growing business communicates with its customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Portfolio or examples of work, particularly presentation are welcomed as part of your application.

IND25

title: Community Engagement Lead
description:
Community Engagement Lead

Salary: £30,000-£33,500 per annum, depending on experience

Hours: 37 hours per week, including some evening and weekend working

Contract: Permanent

Location: Hybrid, with extensive travel across Cambridgeshire, Peterborough and Norfolk

Closing date: 9.00am on 7 October 2026

Are you a natural relationship-builder who enjoys connecting with people and bringing communities together? Could you help raise awareness of unpaid carers and build partnerships that make a meaningful difference?

We are looking for an enthusiastic and engaging Community Engagement Lead to increase awareness of unpaid carers, promote the support available through Caring Together Charity and develop strong relationships across the healthcare, community, business and voluntary sectors.

About Caring Together

For over 40 years, Caring Together Charity has been supporting families who are living with an illness or disability.

Our vision is a world with no unpaid carer in crisis, isolated or struggling alone. Three in five of us will become a carer at some point in our lives, and we are here to provide emotional and practical support and advice to unpaid carers of all ages and their families.

About the role

As our Community Engagement Lead, you will be an ambassador for Caring Together Charity across Cambridgeshire, Peterborough and Norfolk.

You will build meaningful partnerships with healthcare professionals, community and voluntary organisations, local authorities, schools, faith groups and businesses. Through presentations, workshops, networking and community events, you will help more people recognise unpaid carers and understand how our services can support them.

You will also identify opportunities to reach underserved communities, support community fundraising and gather stories and insights that demonstrate the impact of our work.

This is a varied, outward-facing role requiring regular travel and some evening and weekend work. You will have the freedom to manage your own workload, develop new relationships and shape an annual programme of community outreach activity.

What you'll do

You will:
- Build and maintain relationships with GP practices, Primary Care Networks, pharmacies, hospitals, social prescribing teams and other healthcare professionals.
- Develop partnerships with community groups, voluntary organisations, local authorities, schools, faith groups and businesses.
- Represent Caring Together Charity at networking forums, community events, conferences, county shows and health and wellbeing fairs.
- Prepare and deliver engaging presentations, talks, workshops and training sessions.
- Plan and co-ordinate an annual programme of community outreach activities and events.
- Identify underserved communities and develop inclusive approaches to improve awareness and accessibility.
- Create engaging exhibition stands, information displays and resources.
- Build relationships with organisations interested in fundraising, sponsorship or partnership opportunities.
- Support community fundraising initiatives alongside fundraising colleagues.
- Gather case studies, stories, feedback and content for newsletters, social media and other communications.
- Maintain accurate records of contacts, partnerships and engagement activity on our CRM system.
- Monitor outcomes and report against agreed objectives and KPIs.
- Co-ordinate volunteers supporting community outreach and engagement activities.

About you

We are looking for someone who:
- Has experience of proactively working with a range of community partners.
- Is a natural communicator and relationship-builder, with warmth and authenticity.
- Is a confident and engaging public speaker.
- Has experience of delivering presentations and talks to different audiences.
- Can create engaging displays and represent an organisation effectively at events.
- Is highly organised and able to manage their own workload and priorities.
- Can identify and develop new partnership and engagement opportunities.
- Is comfortable using Microsoft Office, including creating PowerPoint presentations.
- Records information accurately and understands the importance of timely reporting.
- Is self-motivated, collaborative and committed to making a positive difference.
- Has a positive, practical and solutions-focused approach.
- Has a full driving licence, access to their own vehicle and the ability to travel extensively across our region.
- Can regularly work evenings and weekends when required.

Experience within healthcare, the voluntary sector or a community engagement role would be an advantage. Knowledge or personal experience of unpaid caring, experience of using Salesforce or another CRM system, and experience of supporting volunteers would also be welcomed.

Skills, attitude and experience are more important to us than specific qualifications.

What you can expect

As part of our team, you will receive:
- A salary of £30,000-£33,500, depending on experience.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- The option to buy or sell annual leave in line with our policy.
- Flexible working arrangements where these can be mutually agreed.
- Time off in lieu for additional evening and weekend hours worked.
- A workplace pension in line with auto-enrolment requirements.
- The opportunity to develop meaningful partnerships and shape community engagement across our region.
- The chance to make a positive difference to unpaid carers and families across Cambridgeshire, Peterborough and Norfolk.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and celebrate different approaches, experiences and points of view.

Caring Together Charity is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults at risk and children. The successful candidate will be required to complete a Disclosure and Barring Service check appropriate to the role.

If you are ready to use your communication skills, creativity and enthusiasm to build stronger communities and help more unpaid carers access the support they need, we would love to hear from you. Apply by 9.00am on 7 October 2026.

title: CRM Officer
description:
CRM Officer

Hybrid working 3 days onsite

A forward-thinking UK higher-education organisation is looking for a CRM Officer to join a collaborative marketing team and help deliver data-driven, insight-led CRM activity. This is a permanent role with hybrid working (approx. 60% campus-based)

You'll play a key part in planning and delivering CRM communications and campaigns, working across the full lifecycle from audience selection and data preparation through to testing, deployment, performance reporting and continuous optimisation.

What you'll be doing
- Supporting CRM programmes and end-to-end campaign delivery, including planning, testing and implementation
- Preparing and segmenting customer data for targeted marketing activity
- Delivering effective B2 C and B2 B digital CRM communications
- Using large datasets to analyse performance and identify actionable insights
- Building dashboards and reporting to measure and communicate KPIs, evaluate markets/products and drive decision-making
- Working within an agile team, including supporting the introduction of a new system and/or marketing strategy
- Handling complex queries with sound judgement, escalating risks appropriately, and delivering a high standard of customer service

What we're looking for
- Proven experience running CRM campaigns and understanding CRM principles and channels
- Hands-on experience with a CRM platform (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Oracle, or similar)
- Strong analytical skills-able to turn data into clear, actionable insight
- Confidence producing performance reporting and dashboards (KPIs, trends, outcomes)
- Clear communication and strong stakeholder management

CRM Officer

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist
- Location: PE6
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a Digital Marketing Specialist to drive the day-to-day execution of our marketing plans. This role is pivotal in managing digital campaigns across PPC, SEO, email, and social media, and supports the Head of Marketing in delivering tactical campaigns and coordinating events. The ideal candidate will be a dynamic marketer with a strong background in digital execution and campaign management.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Implement and manage strategic email marketing and PPC campaigns, tracking performance to optimize lead generation.
- Conduct research to identify potential B2 B customers in sectors like agriculture, wastewater, construction, and events.
- Manage the inbound lead pipeline, coordinate with sales for lead transfers, and nurture customers to maximize conversion rates.
- Write and edit high-quality copy for marketing collateral, product applications, and website landing pages.
- Act as the internal "super-user" for the website, managing routine updates, new product uploads, and on-page SEO optimization.
- Serve as the primary liaison for external digital agencies, providing content assets and monitoring deliverables.
- Coordinate the communication of industry events and trade shows, working closely with the Sales team.
- Create and schedule daily social media posts, including basic graphic design.
- Compile regular analytics reports on digital traffic, email engagement, and competitor activity.
- Manage the marketing mailing list to ensure GDPR compliance.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- 3-5 years of broad marketing experience, with a focus on digital execution, content creation, and campaign coordination.
- Proficient in using digital marketing tools like Canva or Adobe Creative Suite, with a preference for candidates with HubSpot experience.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with experience in managing social media and email campaigns.
- Highly organised and reliable, capable of managing multiple tasks and schedules.
- Strong CRM and analytical skills to maintain accurate lead records and produce insightful reports.
- Team player, comfortable collaborating with external stakeholders and willing to travel for trade shows.
- Proactive and mature mindset, able to manage daily operations and make decisions in the absence of the Head of Marketing.
- Background or interest in rainwater harvesting, water treatment, or B2 B environments is advantageous.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic and supportive work environment.
- Flexible working hours with potential for remote work arrangements.

title: Internal Communications (REMOTE)
description:
Internal Comms and Engagement Officer
- Location: Flexible
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Internal Comms and Engagement Officer to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will connect colleagues to our vision, ensuring accessible information delivery and effective engagement across the organisation. This position offers the opportunity to introduce innovative ideas, challenge existing practices, and creatively enhance internal communications to support our strategic aims.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Lead and manage several of our internal communication channels and engagement forums, including manager communications and colleague forums.
- Gather and share engaging content from across the organisation, enhancing our internal narrative.
- Support the day-to-day delivery of communication and engagement plans, assisting with internal communications for key projects and teams.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation, maintaining high levels of trust and credibility.
- Continuously seek improvements in our communication and engagement strategies, introducing fresh ideas and creative solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience in creating and delivering high-quality, engaging communication campaigns using various channels such as newsletters, intranet, emails, social networks, and digital signage.
- Strong copywriting and editing skills with a keen attention to detail.
- Excellent organisational skills to manage multiple communication projects and meet deadlines.
- Good design skills to create effective content for diverse audiences.
- Exceptional relationship-building skills, capable of establishing trust and developing relationships across all levels.
- Experience with email marketing, editing web content, and using enterprise social networks (Viva Engage desirable).
- Ability to deliver staff engagement activities like events, briefings, or workshops.
- Photo and video editing skills are desirable.

Benefits:
- Competitive annual salary
- 24 days annual leave plus all UK bank holidays
- Excellent pension scheme
- Comprehensive support and training
- Flexible working options
- Additional fantastic benefits

title: Marketing Executive
